lines.trans: Nastya, please stop torturing me.
And why are you angry with me?
You and I argued over a trifle.
For me this question was important.
You yourself wanted to argue a bit yesterday.
But I did not want such a foolish offense.
Forgive me if I hurt you badly.
Do you really regret your words?
I very sincerely ask your forgiveness.
It is also very hard for me to stay angry long.
Let us forget this argument right now.
Good, I agree to make peace with you.
You are the kindest and most beautiful girl.

present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.
examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.trans: He talks for a long time.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

examples.trans: Don't forget to wash the toilet.

злиться.gloss: to be angry, to get mad

meanings.en: to be angry, to get mad

examples.text: А знаешь, почему ты так злишься?
examples.trans: And do you know why you are so angry?
Don't be angry with me, please.
I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!
examples.trans: Because of your Lyolya the whole class calls me a little liar!
We were late because of the rain.

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я вам искренне сочувствую.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I sincerely sympathize with you.
They have a very beautiful house.
I'm going to have to torture you.
Go on then, torture me, Samson!

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.trans: I will not forget this insult.
She was left with bitter resentment.

meanings.en: to offend, to hurt someone's feelings

examples.trans: Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.
He didn't want to offend anyone.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Да перестаньте! Я двадцать лет в карты не играла.
examples.trans: Oh, stop it! I haven't played cards for twenty years.

meanings.en: to make up, to make peace

examples.text: Когда-нибудь ты захочешь помириться со своим папой.
examples.trans: Someday you will want to make up with your dad.

examples.text: Я сто раз хотела с ним помириться!
examples.trans: I wanted to make up with him a hundred times!

поспорить.gloss: to make a bet, wager, argue

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness
просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness, apologise

examples.trans: He is asking me to forgive him.
Is a trifle more important than your son's health?

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: The wind is blowing hard outside.
